Both pathways converge on Cyp2e1, indicating a potential role in metabolic processes or enzyme activity. The integration of these evidence points suggests that Sevoflurane may influence Cyp2e1 through distinct but related mechanisms, possibly involving the modulation of enzyme activity or the induction of metabolic pathways.
